TTF2 had the more ambitious goal to push lasing to 6 nm wavelengths, with a 1 GeV linear
accelerator. This should be achieved in 2007; in the meantime, acceleration of electrons up to
0.75 GeV has obtained lasing at 32 nm (Jan. 2005) and at 13 nm (April 2006), and a vigorous
user program was started in August 2005 in the experiments hall downstream from the free-
